Answers to Frequently Asked Compliance Questions

View the webinar Here

Augusts' Compliance Webinar will feature a Question and Answer session highlighting issues our clients face every day. This webinar will answer frequently asked questions about HIPAA, OSHA and Corporate Compliance. This presentation will give you an idea of what other healthcare professionals are experiencing. There will be a live question and answer segment that we encourage you to participate in as well.
